name: Exp_KWAN_RDP
summary: Exp_KWAN_RDP is a trend-following Expert Advisor based on the KWAN indicator with RDP (Relative Difference Price) smoothing. It enters trades in the direction of the KWAN trend signal after RDP confirmation, aiming to capture sustained directional moves. The EA applies systematic entry and exit rules without manual intervention.
summary_zh: Exp_KWAN_RDP是一个基于KWAN指标和RDP（相对差价）平滑的趋势跟踪EA。它在KWAN趋势信号经RDP确认后沿趋势方向入场，旨在捕获持续的方向性行情。该EA采用系统化的入场和出场规则，无需手动干预。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过KWAN指标判断市场趋势方向，利用RDP平滑过滤假信号。入场条件为KWAN指标发出趋势信号且RDP确认方向一致时开仓做多或做空。出场条件通常包括反向信号触发或固定止损/止盈水平。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户资金的动态手数分配方式。资金管理方面，该EA依赖止损来控制单笔风险，但具体的风险百分比设置需根据参数配置而定。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的指标驱动型趋势跟踪系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, using the KWAN indicator to determine market trend direction and RDP smoothing to filter out false signals. Entry conditions require the KWAN indicator to generate a trend signal with RDP confirmation in the same direction before opening a long or short position. Exit conditions typically include a reverse signal trigger or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or dynamic allocation based on account equity. Money management relies on stop-losses to control per-trade risk, though the specific risk percentage depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear and represents a typical indicator-driven trend following system, suitable for trending markets but may generate frequent false signals in ranging conditions.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to identify its orders

pros: 趋势跟踪逻辑清晰，在大趋势行情中表现良好
RDP平滑机制有效减少假信号和频繁交易
系统化执行消除情绪干扰，纪律性强
pros_en: Clear trend following logic that performs well in strong trending markets
RDP smoothing mechanism effectively reduces false signals and overtrading
Systematic execution eliminates emotional interference with strong discipline
cons: 震荡市场中容易产生连续亏损和假信号
固定止损止盈可能不适应所有市场波动环境
缺乏动态仓位管理，资金利用效率不高
cons_en: Prone to consecutive losses and false signals in ranging/sideways markets
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit may not adapt to all market volatility conditions
Lacks dynamic position sizing, resulting in suboptimal capital efficiency
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤器，在震荡行情中减少交易频率
引入ATR动态止损止盈，适应不同市场波动环境
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter to reduce trading frequency during ranging markets
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt to varying market volatility

risk_points: 固定止损可能在剧烈波动时被滑点穿越
缺乏账户整体风险控制机制，多品种同时运行时风险叠加
无最大回撤限制，持续亏损时无自动保护
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss may be slipped through during extreme volatility
Lacks overall account risk control; risk compounds when running on multiple instruments simultaneously
No maximum drawdown limit or automatic protection during sustained losses
